title: Prefix labelled-deletion cancellation in the first Cech sorting homotopy
statement:
Let $I$ be a linearly ordered type, $A$ an abelian group, $p\ge0$, $n=p+2$,
$t:\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to I$, and $f:(\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to\operatorname{Fin}(n))\to A$
an arbitrary function. Use stable sorting, partial sorting, and junction maps
[def-pc-alternating-cech-sorting-operators]. For $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$ let
$\delta_j:\operatorname{Fin}(n-1)\to\operatorname{Fin}(n)$ be the increasing map omitting $j$.
For $r\in\operatorname{Fin}(n+1)$, $\delta_r$ similarly omits $r$.
Write $C_t(\sigma,\tau,a)$ for the conjunction that $\sigma$ is the stable sort of $t$
and $\tau$ is its partial sort with prefix length $a$.
For $\rho,\eta\in S_{n-1}$ and $b\in\operatorname{Fin}(n-1)$ put
$k=\delta_j(\rho(b))$ and $B(j,\rho,b):\Leftrightarrow t(j)<t(k)\ \lor\ (t(j)=t(k)\land j<k)$.
Then
$$
\sum_{\substack{\sigma,\tau\in S_n,\ a\in\operatorname{Fin}(n),\ r\in\operatorname{Fin}(n+1)\\
 C_t(\sigma,\tau,a),\ q_{\sigma,\tau,a}(r)\ne\sigma(a),\ r<a}}
 (-1)^{a+r}\operatorname{sign}(\tau)\,f(q_{\sigma,\tau,a}\circ\delta_r)
 +
\sum_{\substack{j\in\operatorname{Fin}(n),\ \rho,\eta\in S_{n-1},\ b\in\operatorname{Fin}(n-1)\\
 C_{t\circ\delta_j}(\rho,\eta,b),\ B(j,\rho,b)}}
 (-1)^{j+b}\operatorname{sign}(\eta)\,f(\delta_j\circ q_{\rho,\eta,b})=0,
$$
where $q_{\sigma,\tau,a}=\operatorname{cechJunction}(\sigma,\tau,a)$ and $S_m$ is the
permutation group of $\operatorname{Fin}(m)$. Integer coefficients act by repeated addition.

source.place: Tag 01FM, cohomology-equation-first-homotopy (20.23.6.1), omitted verification; prefix labelled-deletion part; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01FM

proof.text: First remove the redundant outgoing nonjunction filter: r<a puts the junction value at σ(r), which differs from σ(a) by injectivity (proved local prefix_nonjunction and prefix_filter). Rewrite the four nested filtered outgoing and incoming sums as sums over the subtypes CechPrefixOutgoing and CechPrefixIncoming, using Fintype.sum_prod_type' and Finset.sum_subtype (local sum_subtype_ite). Obtain the unsigned correspondence and its restriction equations from [lem-pc-alternating-cech-prefix-deletion-bijection].

For corresponding indices, use the two restriction equations and a=b+1 to identify the deleted outgoing junction with the incoming label map. The proved local junction_restrict splits at k≤b and checks the values of succAbove in each branch. Apply the proved local sign_restrict: conjugating τ by j.cycleRange on the left and r.cycleRange inverse on the right gives decomposeFin.symm(0,η). Mathlib sign_cycleRange and decomposeFin.symm_sign yield sign η=(-1)^j sign τ (-1)^r. Together with a=b+1 and ((-1)^j)^2=1, integer ring arithmetic makes the incoming coefficient the negative of the outgoing coefficient. The evaluated f arguments agree, so neg_smul gives u(x)=-z(e(x)).

Apply Fintype.sum_equiv to the correspondence and the pointwise equality u(x)=-z(e(x)); then Finset.sum_neg_distrib and neg_add_cancel finish. All these summation and coefficient steps are proved in Lean, with no additional holes.

lean.statement:
theorem cechFirstSortingPrefixCancellation
    {I : Type v} [LinearOrder I] {B : Type w} [AddCommGroup B]
    (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 2) → I) (f : (Fin (p + 2) → Fin (p + 2)) → B) :
    let before := fun (j : Fin (p + 2)) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 1)))
        (b : Fin (p + 1)) ↦
      t j < t (j.succAbove (σ b)) ∨
        (t j = t (j.succAbove (σ b)) ∧ j < j.succAbove (σ b))
    (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2)), ∑ a : Fin (p + 2),
      ∑ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2)), ∑ r : Fin (p + 3),
        if ((cechStableSort t σ ∧ cechPartialSort σ τ a) ∧
            cechJunction σ τ a r ≠ σ a) ∧ r.val < a.val then
          (((-1 : ℤ) ^ a.val * (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ)) * (-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
            f (cechJunction σ τ a ∘ r.succAbove) else 0) +
      (∑ j : Fin (p + 2), ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 1)), ∑ b : Fin (p + 1),
        ∑ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 1)),
          if (cechStableSort (t ∘ j.succAbove) σ ∧ cechPartialSort σ τ b) ∧
              before j σ b then
            ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val * ((-1 : ℤ) ^ b.val * (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ))) •
              f (j.succAbove ∘ cechJunction σ τ b) else 0) = 0
